variant.name: C2t_Vsafe_R35
variant.definition: C2t_Vsafe (B3-A d = 0 AC solution as initial condition) plus an incremental preventive redispatch of SG35 to the GFM

redispatch.rule: frozen delta = delta_min rounded up to the next multiple of 0.005 pu (declared before running); the investigator can replace it

verdict.reason: pre- and post-event states belong to C_H and the QP is feasible

model_error.power_balance_note: independent nodal balance: valid pre-event and in Q+ (5.6e-6 pu); in P+ after the event it equals the load step (0.5856 pu) because the PQ parameter used for the sum does not carry the Alter step (bookkeeping artefact, not a DAE residual)

verdict.reason: post-event state is outside C_H and/or the QP is infeasible right after the load step; closed-loop protection is NOT authorized for this scenario

derivatives of order >= 2 from the frozen Jacobian; reference derivatives from polynomial fits of the nonlinear series
